---
title: "Create Signac Object"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Create a Signac chromatin assay object from counts, fragments, and metadata.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/peak_count_matrix.qs"
metadata_file <- "path/to/cell_metadata.tsv"
fragments_file <- "path/to/fragments.tsv.gz"
output_object <- "path/to/signac_created.qs"
results_dir <- "results/create_signac"
figures_dir <- "figures/create_signac"
assay_name <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
genome_name <- "genome_placeholder"
min_cells <- 10
min_features <- 200
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
counts <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
metadata <- readr::read_tsv(metadata_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(is.matrix(counts) || inherits(counts, "Matrix"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column) %in% colnames(metadata)))
stopifnot(file.exists(fragments_file))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(peaks = nrow(counts), cells = ncol(counts)), file.path(results_dir, "signac_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
chrom_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(counts = counts, sep = c(":", "-"), genome = genome_name, fragments = fragments_file, min.cells = min_cells)
metadata <- metadata |> tibble::column_to_rownames(colnames(metadata)[1])
object <- CreateSeuratObject(chrom_assay, assay = assay_name, meta.data = metadata[colnames(counts), , drop = FALSE], min.features = min_features)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
object <- NucleosomeSignal(object)
object <- TSSEnrichment(object)
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "signac_qc_metrics.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "signac_qc.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(object, features = c("nCount_peaks", "nucleosome_signal", "TSS.enrichment"), group.by = sample_column, pt.size = 0))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$template <- list(step = "create_signac_object", fragments_file = fragments_file)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "created_signac_metadata.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-01-create-signac-object-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, cells = ncol(object), peaks = nrow(object))
```
